import importlib, importlib.metadata, importlib.resources, json, pathlib, site, sys
roots = [pathlib.Path(path).resolve() for path in site.getsitepackages()]
origins = {}
for name in ('residual_core', 'resasm_user', 'umat_oti', 'umat_oti.provider.build',
             'residual_core.replay.presentation', 'residual_core.app.streamlit_app',
             'umat_oti.app.streamlit_app'):
    path = pathlib.Path(importlib.import_module(name).__file__).resolve()
    assert any(root in path.parents for root in roots), (name, path, roots)
    origins[name] = str(path)
for distribution in importlib.metadata.distributions():
    direct = distribution.read_text('direct_url.json')
    assert not direct or not json.loads(direct).get('dir_info', {}).get('editable'), direct
resources = {}
requirements = {
    'residual_core': ['example_manifest.json', 'umat_adapter_fortran/umat_driver.f90',
                      'umat_adapter_fortran/aba_stubs/*.f*'],
    'residual_core.replay': ['contract/CONTRACT_VERSION.json', 'contract/resasm_mat_abi_v1.h'],
    'umat_oti.oti': ['support/*.f90', 'support/pyoti_templates/*.f90'],
    'umat_oti.contract': ['schemas/*.json', 'contract_lock.json'],
}
for package, patterns in requirements.items():
    root = pathlib.Path(str(importlib.resources.files(package)))
    resources[package] = []
    for pattern in patterns:
        matches = list(root.glob(pattern))
        assert matches, (package, pattern)
        assert all(path.stat().st_size for path in matches)
        resources[package].extend(str(path) for path in matches)
assert sys.prefix != sys.base_prefix
assert not site.ENABLE_USER_SITE
for path in sys.path:
    assert not any(pathlib.Path(root).resolve() == pathlib.Path(path).resolve()
                   or pathlib.Path(root).resolve() in pathlib.Path(path).resolve().parents
                   for root in sys.argv[1:]), (path, sys.argv[1:])
print(json.dumps(dict(origins=origins, resources=resources, sys_path=sys.path,
                     executable=sys.executable, version=sys.version), indent=2))

import importlib.util, json
from streamlit.testing.v1 import AppTest
results = {}
for name in ('residual_core.app.streamlit_app', 'umat_oti.app.streamlit_app'):
    path = importlib.util.find_spec(name).origin
    app = AppTest.from_file(path, default_timeout=60).run()
    assert not app.exception, [str(error) for error in app.exception]
    assert len(app.title) or len(app.header), name
    results[name] = dict(path=path, titles=[item.value for item in app.title],
                         tabs=[item.label for item in app.tabs])
print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))

UMAT-OTI rewrites an Abaqus UMAT so that its consistent tangent is computed, not written. In a hand-written UMAT, DDSDDE is an algebraic expression somebody derived and typed - the part that is wrong when a material model is wrong. This tool lifts the stress update into order-truncated imaginary (OTI) arithmetic, seeds the strain increment with imaginary directions, and reads the exact derivative straight back out of the result.

What you give it

Your UMAT source, plus a small JSON contract that names the routine, NTENS, the derivative order, and which variables are seeded. 26 contracts already ship with this checkout.

What you get back

A drop-in Abaqus user subroutine whose DDSDDE is the exact tangent, the OTI modules it needs, a compile script, and a report listing every structural check the generator ran on its own output.

What it refuses to do

Transform a source whose tangent it cannot locate, or claim a check passed that it did not run. A blocked source is reported with the reason, before anything is written.

import argparse
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request

from playwright.sync_api import expect, sync_playwright


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--inputs", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    reports = {}
    for name in ("residual_core", "umat_oti"):
        module = name + ".app.streamlit_app"
        origin = Path(importlib.util.find_spec(module).origin).resolve()
        assert origin.is_relative_to(Path(sys.prefix).resolve()), origin
        with socket.socket() as listener:
            listener.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
            port = listener.getsockname()[1]
        command = [sys.executable, "-I", "-m", "streamlit", "run", str(origin),
                   "--server.address=127.0.0.1", f"--server.port={port}",
                   "--server.headless=true", "--browser.gatherUsageStats=false"]
        report = {"argv": command, "origin": str(origin), "passed": False}
        reports[name] = report
        with (args.out / (name + ".log")).open("w") as log:
            server = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=args.out, env=os.environ.copy(),
                                      stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
            report["pid"] = server.pid
            url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"
            try:
                with sync_playwright() as playwright:
                    browser = playwright.chromium.launch(headless=True)
                    page = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 1100})
                    deadline = time.monotonic() + 45
                    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
                        assert server.poll() is None, "server exited"
                        try:
                            with urllib.request.urlopen(url + "/_stcore/health", timeout=1) as response:
                                if response.status == 200:
                                    break
                        except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError):
                            page.wait_for_timeout(100)
                    else:
                        raise AssertionError("server readiness timeout")
                    page.goto(url)
                    expect(page.locator("h1").first).to_be_visible(timeout=60000)
                    report["headings"] = page.locator("h1,h2,h3").all_text_contents()
                    if name == "residual_core":
                        expect(page.get_by_role("heading", name="Residual Sensitivity Solver", exact=True)).to_be_visible()
                        for filename in ("OTI_UMAT.obj", "Analysis.inp", "Analysis.odb", "sensitivity_request.json"):
                            page.get_by_label(filename + " path", exact=True).fill(str(args.inputs / filename))
                        page.get_by_label("Output directory", exact=True).fill(str(args.out / "results"))
                        page.get_by_role("button", name="Run sensitivity request", exact=True).click()
                        expect(page.get_by_text("Executed: 4 scalar results. Independent validation: not run.", exact=True)).to_be_visible(timeout=90000)
                        for filename in ("sensitivity_results.json", "sensitivity_tables.csv", "run_report.txt"):
                            with page.expect_download() as downloading:
                                page.get_by_role("button", name=filename, exact=True).click()
                            download = downloading.value
                            assert download.suggested_filename == filename
                            target = args.out / ("download_" + filename)
                            download.save_as(target)
                            assert target.read_bytes() == (args.out / "results" / filename).read_bytes()
                        actual = json.loads((args.out / "results/sensitivity_results.json").read_text())
                        reference = json.loads((args.inputs / "results/sensitivity_results.json").read_text())
                        assert actual["results"] == reference["results"]
                        report["numerical_results_match_cli"] = True
                    else:
                        report["disabled_buttons"] = page.get_by_role("button", disabled=True).all_text_contents()
                        report["body_text"] = page.locator("body").inner_text()
                        report["workflow_scope"] = "Installed startup and navigation only; disabled demo controls remain a blocker."
                    report["tabs"] = page.get_by_role("tab").all_text_contents()
                    page.screenshot(path=str(args.out / (name + "_desktop.png")), full_page=True)
                    page.set_viewport_size({"width": 390, "height": 844})
                    expect(page.locator("h1").first).to_be_visible()
                    page.screenshot(path=str(args.out / (name + "_mobile.png")), full_page=True)
                    report["horizontal_overflow"] = page.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth > window.innerWidth")
                    assert not report["horizontal_overflow"]
                    assert page.locator('[data-testid="stException"]').count() == 0
                    report["passed"] = True
                    browser.close()
            except Exception as error:
                report["error"] = repr(error)
            finally:
                server.terminate()
                try:
                    server.wait(timeout=15)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    server.kill()
                    server.wait(timeout=5)
                report["server_returncode"] = server.returncode
                report["server_stopped"] = server.poll() is not None
                (args.out / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps(reports, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(reports, indent=2))
    return 0 if all(report["passed"] for report in reports.values()) else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

import numpy as np


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = args.root.resolve()
    ra = root / "Residual_Assembler"
    umat = root / "UMAT_source_transformation"
    work = root / "samples_outputs"
    assert not work.exists()
    report = {"commands": [], "rounds": [], "comparisons": {}, "origins": {}}
    for name in ("residual_core", "resasm_user", "umat_oti"):
        origin = Path(importlib.import_module(name).__file__).resolve()
        assert origin.is_relative_to(Path(sys.prefix).resolve()), origin
        report["origins"][name] = str(origin)

    def save():
        (root / "samples_report.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")

    def run(label, arguments, cwd=work):
        command = [str(value) for value in arguments]
        entry = {"label": label, "argv": command, "cwd": str(cwd)}
        completed = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, env=os.environ.copy(), capture_output=True, text=True)
        log = root / "logs" / f"sample_{len(report['commands']):03d}.log"
        log.write_text(completed.stdout + completed.stderr)
        entry.update(returncode=completed.returncode, log=str(log))
        report["commands"].append(entry)
        save()
        print(label, "exit", completed.returncode, flush=True)
        if completed.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError(str(log) + ": " + (completed.stdout + completed.stderr)[-1800:])

    def scientific(value):
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            ignored = ("seconds", "elapsed", "duration", "timestamp", "sha256", "path", "command", "argv", "environment", "repository", "repositories")
            return {key: scientific(item) for key, item in value.items()
                    if not any(term in key.lower() for term in ignored) and scientific(item) is not None}
        if isinstance(value, list):
            return [scientific(item) for item in value if scientific(item) is not None]
        if isinstance(value, (int, float, bool)) or value is None:
            return value
        if isinstance(value, str) and not ("/" in value or "\\" in value):
            return value
        return None

    cli = [sys.executable, "-I", "-m", "residual_core.ui.cli"]
    for iteration in (1, 2):
        work.mkdir()
        cases = {}
        report["rounds"].append(cases)
        for label in ("R-X1", "R-X2", "R-X3", "R-X4", "R-X5", "U-X1", "U-X2", "U-X3", "U-X4", "U-X5"):
            record = {"passed": False, "installed_commands": label != "R-X4"}
            cases[label] = record
            destination = work / label
            try:
                if label in ("R-X1", "R-X2"):
                    template = "python" if label == "R-X1" else "blackbox-order2"
                    run(label + " init", cli + ["init", "--template", template, "--out", destination])
                    run(label + " check", cli + ["check", destination / "resasm.yml"])
                    run(label, cli + ["run", destination / "resasm.yml"])
                    expected = ({(1, 0): -1/3, (0, 1): 1/24, (2, 0): 2/9, (1, 1): -1/144, (0, 2): -1/576}
                                if label == "R-X1" else
                                {(1, 0): -2/3, (0, 1): 1/48, (2, 0): 5/9, (1, 1): -1/144, (0, 2): -1/2304})
                    checks = []
                    private = destination / "resasm_output/private"
                    for order in (1, 2):
                        mapping = json.loads((private / f"direction_map_order{order}.json").read_text())
                        with np.load(private / f"solution_sensitivities_order{order}.npz") as values:
                            for column in mapping["columns"]:
                                measured = float(values["U_derivatives"][0, column["index"]])
                                reference = expected[tuple(column["exponents"])]
                                assert abs(measured - reference) < 1e-8
                                checks.append({"direction": column["exponents"], "measured": measured, "reference": reference})
                    record["science"] = checks
                    run(label + " report", cli + ["report", destination / "resasm_output"])
                elif label == "R-X3":
                    model = ra / "residual_core/examples/minimal_c3d8_stress_driven"
                    run(label, cli + ["assemble", model / "model.json", "--mode", "stress-driven", "--fields", model / "fields.json", "--out", work / "stress.npy"])
                    residual = np.load(work / "stress.npy")
                    assert np.isclose(np.linalg.norm(residual), 100 / np.sqrt(2), atol=1e-10, rtol=0)
                    assert np.isclose(np.max(np.abs(residual)), 25, atol=1e-10, rtol=0)
                    record["science"] = residual.tolist()
                elif label == "R-X4":
                    run(label, [sys.executable, "-I", ra / "scripts/reproduce_imqcam_pipeline.py", "--provider-repo", umat, "--skip-abaqus", "--out", destination], cwd=ra)
                    manifest = json.loads((destination / "private/manifest.json").read_text())
                    assert manifest["passed"]
                    record["science"] = scientific({key: manifest[key] for key in ("verification", "max_equilibrium_error", "abaqus_fixture")})
                    record["source_import_boundary"] = "Committed reproducer inserts clone sources; not an installed-command proof."
                elif label == "R-X5":
                    run(label, [sys.executable, "-I", ra / "examples/finite_strain_c3d8/benchmark.py", "--out", destination])
                    data = json.loads((destination / "report.json").read_text())
                    assert data["passed"]
                    record["science"] = scientific(data)
                    run(label + " assembly", cli + ["--config", destination / "config.json", "assemble", destination / "model.json", "--mode", "material-replay", "--tangent"])
                    run(label + " sensitivity", cli + ["--config", destination / "config.json", "sensitivity", destination / "model.json", "--params", destination / "params.json", "--out", destination / "sensitivity"])
                else:
                    if label == "U-X5":
                        arguments = [sys.executable, "-I", umat / "examples/verify_internal_jacobian.py", "--out", destination]
                    else:
                        model_name = "m1_elastic" if label == "U-X1" else "m3_j2"
                        arguments = [sys.executable, "-I", "-m", "umat_oti.validation.parameter_sensitivity_provider", umat / "parameter_sensitivity/models" / model_name / "contract_v2.json", "--out", destination]
                        if label == "U-X1":
                            arguments.append("--elastic")
                    run(label, arguments)
                    data = json.loads((destination / "verification.json").read_text())
                    assert data["passed"]
                    record["science"] = scientific(data)
                record["passed"] = True
            except Exception as error:
                record["error"] = repr(error)
            save()
        if iteration == 1:
            report["deleted_output_inventory"] = {str(path.relative_to(work)): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                                                   for path in work.rglob("*") if path.is_file()}
            save()
            assert work.parent == root and work.name == "samples_outputs"
            shutil.rmtree(work)
    for label, first in report["rounds"][0].items():
        second = report["rounds"][1][label]
        report["comparisons"][label] = {"both_passed": first["passed"] and second["passed"],
                                          "scientifically_identical": first.get("science") == second.get("science") if first["passed"] and second["passed"] else None}
    save()
    print(json.dumps(report["comparisons"], indent=2))
    return 0 if all(item["both_passed"] and item["scientifically_identical"] for item in report["comparisons"].values()) else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
